quest.title: Problem Conversion: Theory Reliability
quest.description: Rafiq's design has entered its final stretch...

dialogues.speaker: Qishan
dialogues.text: ...That's why I'd submit that we can't scrimp too much on material in this area.

dialogues.speaker: Rafiq
dialogues.text: Don't worry, its strength is good enough. I've done the necessary calculations many times.

dialogues.speaker: Qishan
dialogues.text: Argh, I've told you this before. Many problems cannot simply be solved by calculation...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: What are you guys arguing about?

dialogues.speaker: Rafiq
dialogues.text: Oh, it's you. We're discussing the design problems of that ship of mine.

dialogues.speaker: Rafiq
dialogues.text: I've done plenty of calculations, and I can guarantee that every area has enough strength.

dialogues.speaker: Rafiq
dialogues.text: But Qishan stubbornly claims that the calculated strength is not necessarily reliable...

dialogues.speaker: Qishan
dialogues.text: The "strength" that you're talking about only exists in theory.

dialogues.speaker: Qishan
dialogues.text: The ship will have to withstand pressure while in the water, and that will be way more than the numbers you have here.

dialogues.speaker: Rafiq
dialogues.text: I understand the logic, but my finances are limited, and...

dialogues.speaker: Rafiq
dialogues.text: If I buy more expensive materials, I will only be able to finish the keel of this ship at most... *cough*!

dialogues.speaker: Rafiq
dialogues.text: Anyway! Let's just follow my plan for this ship for now. I've already purchased all the materials.

dialogues.speaker: Rafiq
dialogues.text: Traveler, if you're willing, could you help me carry some materials? I can't carry them all by myself...

response.speaker: Rafiq
response.text: I'm leaving it to you then, as I have calculations to work with. I'll fetch the rest after I'm done...

response.speaker: Rafiq
response.text: Oh, she does. She's even faster than me when it comes to certain calculations, actually.

response.speaker: Rafiq
response.text: I have no idea why she wants to be a helper here, really...

talks.objective: Fetch the materials for building the ship

dialogues.speaker: Qishan
dialogues.text: The material strengths required for the hull, as per Rafiq's calculations, are indeed correct based on the theoretical data alone.

dialogues.speaker: Qishan
dialogues.text: But if you really want to go into the water...

dialogues.speaker: Qishan
dialogues.text: Forget it, he's surely not going to listen to me...

talks.objective: Fetch the materials for building the ship
Return and report the situation to Rafiq

dialogues.speaker: Rafiq
dialogues.text: So? Have you finished moving the materials over?

talks.objective: Return and report the situation to Rafiq

dialogues.speaker: Rafiq
dialogues.text: Oh! Thanks, Traveler. Here's your payment.

dialogues.speaker: Rafiq
dialogues.text: But this material is really unexpectedly heavy...

dialogues.speaker: Rafiq
dialogues.text: I'll start working as soon as possible. This won't take long, so this ship should be ready for a seaworthiness test soon.

dialogues.speaker: Qishan
dialogues.text: ...You'll have to have your life jackets on ready when you test the ship.

dialogues.speaker: Rafiq
dialogues.text: Oh, it will be fine, for sure! Have some faith in me.

dialogues.speaker: Rafiq
dialogues.text: We are running out of budget. We'd better save some money...
